shortDescription.default: Form Studio - design custom SharePoint list forms without Power Apps

longDescription.default: A drag-and-drop form designer for SharePoint lists, plus a form customizer that replaces the list's New, Edit and Display forms and a web part that puts a form on any page. Layouts with sections, tabs and wizards; conditional visibility, required and read-only rules; calculated and default values; validation; cascading lookups; audience-specific forms; approval buttons; and inline related items. Uses only SharePoint REST APIs - no Azure AD app registration, no Power Apps licence.

features.title: Form Studio Feature
features.description: Deploys the Form Studio web parts and form customizer.
